status: EXISTS for capacity (the media buyer's adapter is strict and tested: tests/replies.test.ts); PROPOSED for ad-signals. Source of truth: System 7 (MKory18/AIresponse, which also holds contracts/oms-app-events.v1). This file is the media buyer's side of it.
direction: PULL — the media buyer calls System 7 every 15 minutes.

auth.rule: OAuth 2.1 + PKCE, exactly like the media buyer's own /mcp connector (reference implementation, public: src/core/oauth.ts + src/server/oauth.ts in the media buyer repo). The system that OWNS the data is the authorization server; the owner presses «اربط ← اسمح» once; nobody copies a token. The Bearer header on each call is unchanged.

endpoints.authorize: GET /oauth/authorize (the owner is logged in to that system and approves)
endpoints.token: POST /oauth/token (authorization_code + code_verifier S256, refresh_token with rotation)

auth.lifetimes: access token about one hour; refresh token about 60 days, rotated on every use; a revoked client or grant is refused on the very next call
auth.refused: a redirect address that was not registered, a missing or wrong PKCE verifier, a code used twice
auth.status: ADD — on the authorization server's side (small if it copies the reference implementation; additive; the old per-system keys can keep working until the owner switches)

rate_limit: the media buyer calls once per 15 minutes; allow at least 12 per minute (429 → it waits for the next tick)

endpoints.change: Let System 7 be the authorization server for its /api/v1 door: a consent screen («الميديا باير بدّه يقرا قدرة الردود — اسمح؟») issuing the same scoped token the door already checks (system = mediabuyer).
endpoints.size: small — reuses the door's token table and scopes

endpoints.notes: STRICT: any field not listed is refused by the media buyer (so a customer field can never slip in). `at` must carry an offset. The media buyer's verdict: down (no answer) · stale (> 2 h) · behind (unanswered > 50) · slow (median first reply > 30 min). Any of them freezes SCALE-UP of message ad sets (never pauses, never lowers); lifted when good again.

endpoints.change: A new read-only endpoint over data System 7 already holds: per ad and per day, counts only (conversations, handoffs by reason, drafted and confirmed orders), a bucket under 5 left out.

query.since: YYYY-MM-DD, required, at most 31 days back

errors.when: since missing or older than 31 days

endpoints.notes: Counts only. A bucket under 5 conversations is suppressed (left out), so no single person can be inferred. `ad_id` is the real Meta ad id (Messenger referral.ad_id, WhatsApp source_id), which joins straight to the media buyer. Not needed for any of the five minimum sets; it feeds the rule «many conversations, few orders».
endpoints.size: medium but additive — a new read-only endpoint over data System 7 already holds

$comment: Written by the media buyer (docs/INTEGRATION_CONTRACTS.md). A published version never breaks: only optional fields are added; a removed, renamed or retyped field is v2. No customer name, phone or address in any field, under any name.
